scope: Human-like agent inspection of the model's actual RGB96x96 development inputs; selected high-confidence raw errors, not a representative or independent blind sample.

observations.finding: Clear visible object/class confusions: tree to chair, apples to carrot, carrots to banana, chairs to carrot/mug, books to carrot/banana/chair/mug. These errors cannot all be explained by wording or disputed source labels.

Unsupported-object negatives include spoon, bowl, creamer, kettle and pear; the raw classifier assigns admitted names to them. Thresholded abstention remains necessary; these negative names are NOT newly learned vocabulary.

Flag for separate admission review at actual input resolution: dense small-object scene, camouflaged/small underwater target, and mixed fruit scene respectively. Do not automatically correct gold from these thumbnails. Inspect acquired source bytes and the exact prepared pixels before any later relabel/exclusion.

future_data_admission_requirements: Review the exact RGB96x96 pixels after all deterministic preparation, not only a larger source thumbnail or title.
A generic whole-frame naming question must have an identifiable admitted target at the actual input resolution; ambiguous target selection requires exclusion or a separately designed localized task.
Freeze source IDs, author grouping, pixel hashes and explicit review decisions before training; use a fresh version for every correction.
Do not infer gold from current model predictions, source category/title or the desire to improve scores.
Do not retrospectively change published metrics, known evaluation gold, or the current five-iteration dataset.
limits: This records direct visible failure examples and review candidates, not a proof of the sole bottleneck, new verified labels, source-family independence, or general visual competence.
